## 01 BMW Group and Solid Power Advance All-Solid-State Battery Development with Samsung SDI
The BMW Group and Solid Power have announced a new partnership with Samsung SDI to advance the development of all-solid-state batteries (ASSBs) for electric vehicles. This collaboration aims to accelerate the commercialization of solid-state batteries, which promise improved safety, range, and performance compared to traditional lithium-ion batteries. According to the [BMW Group](https://news.google.?oc=5), the partnership will focus on developing high-performance ASSBs with improved energy density, charging speeds, and lifespan.

## 02 Verge Motorcycles Launches First Production Motorcycles with Solid-State Battery Technology
Verge Motorcycles has made history by launching the first production motorcycles equipped with solid-state battery technology. This innovative battery technology enables improved safety, range, and performance for electric motorcycles. According to [Verge Motorcycles](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE9IaUhVZ29EeEplXzJmSjRFZVVpc1dIS3BMakgxYUJZNnk2VzlENmpaT1l0Rl8xY1JtQmxzc1hSRGVqY3ZJeHhBRzFmd3g1d3Z0bUE0WnRkNlloSFBRejJEbnVURWFMSUZqQjBfTXRaQjFVZ2FXazNuVFdLd1Q?oc=5), the solid-state batteries provide a significant increase in range and performance, making them ideal for high-performance electric motorcycles.

## 03 KERI Resolves Interfacial Instability in All-Solid-State Battery Commercialization
The Korea Electrotechnology Research Institute (KERI) has announced a breakthrough in resolving interfacial instability in all-solid-state battery commercialization. This achievement could lead to the widespread adoption of solid-state batteries in electric vehicles and other applications. According to [Newswise](https://news.google.?oc=5), the resolution of interfacial instability is a critical step towards the commercialization of solid-state batteries.
